title: [SUG] Remove Crusade Map

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
There are sooooooo many ways to get around a kill farm, it shouldn't be anywhere near a problem. You can go through the back, dig under, build up, try fighting them? Half of the farmers aren't actually that skilled, it's their armour and swords that's keeping them alive.


Its a fine map and has great gameplay. IMO, -1 to this idea, sorry. :{
